<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_Internship"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Internship" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Internship">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_You" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Internship</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterTopicAndMoney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DetailsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DecideOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AcceptOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InvalidateOtherOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_UpdatesSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_YourStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_UpdatesJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinishInternship</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Recommend</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTweets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Recommended</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotRecommended</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Company" name="Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompanyStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Internship" name="Begin internship search"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" name="Enter an interesting topic and desired amount of money"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetails" name="Enter experience and hobbies?" default="Flow_SkipDetails"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DetailsMerge" name="Continue"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive an offer"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideOffer" name="Accept or deny the offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcceptOffer" name="Accept the offer?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_UpdatesSplit" name="Begin status updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_YourStatusUpdates" name="Write at least 3 status updates about the internship (weekly)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates" name="Write 3 status updates about you"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_UpdatesJoin" name="Status updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishInternship" name="Finish the internship"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Recommend" name="Recommend the company?" default="Flow_NoRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendTweets" name="Send a separate recommendation tweet to each friend via Twitter">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">number of friends on the list</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Recommended" name="Company recommended"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotRecommended" name="Internship finished without a recommendation"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Enter" sourceRef="StartEvent_Internship" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enter_Optional" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterDetails" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">enter experience and hobbies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipDetails" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Gateway_DetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Details_Merge" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_DetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_ReceiveOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_DetailsMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Decide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Task_DecideOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_DecideOffer" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accept" name="Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offer accepted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deny" name="Deny" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offer denied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invalidate_Split" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Gateway_UpdatesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_YourUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_UpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_YourStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CompanyUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_UpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_YourUpdates_Join" sourceRef="Task_YourStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_UpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyUpdates_Join" sourceRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_UpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Finish" sourceRef="Gateway_UpdatesJoin" targetRef="Task_FinishInternship"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Finish_Recommend" sourceRef="Task_FinishInternship" targetRef="Gateway_Recommend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecommendYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Recommend" targetRef="Task_SendTweets">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">recommend the company</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRecommendation" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Recommend" targetRef="EndEvent_NotRecommended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tweets_End" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="EndEvent_Recommended"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
